TestPaxos::test_replica_availability.description: 3-node RF=3 cluster (one node per rack). LWT INSERT IF NOT EXISTS with all up; stop node3 -> LWT succeeds (quorum); stop node2 -> LWT raises Unavailable; restart node2 -> LWT succeeds; restart node3 -> LWT succeeds. Ported Cassandra regression for CASSANDRA-8640 (LWT required all replicas instead of quorum). No read-back of written values; only that statements don't error / raise Unavailable.

TestPaxos::test_topology_change_in_prese.description: 6 nodes in 3 racks, RF=3. Starts one LoadThread per node doing LWT UPDATE ... IF EXISTS (plus plain INSERTs) in a loop; after 10s keeps one node per rack and stops the other 3 at once, then removenode's them one by one from a surviving node, passing --ignore-dead-nodes with the still-dead ones. Only implicit assertion: every nodetool removenode succeeds (NodetoolError otherwise). LoadThread results/errors are never checked. Originally (2020) a random add/remove-node soak under LWT load for scylla#7087 seedless-cluster issues; rewritten 2026-08 for DTEST-21 after scylladb#13914 forbade bootstrap with a down node.

TestPaxos::test_topology_change_in_prese.reason: Only real check is that sequential removenode --ignore-dead-nodes succeeds, which scylla test_raft_ignore_nodes.py::test_raft_remove_ignore_nodes / test_tablets_removenode.py::test_removenode_with_ignored_node cover; the LWT load is noise because LoadThread swallows all errors and results are never asserted (paxos_tests.py:48,54 bare excepts). Note: insert failure stores None then `None += 1` TypeError silently swallowed; LoadThread._current unused. Note: commit 4c1d34ba claims LWT QUORUM stays reachable, but with 3 racks x 2 nodes, RF=3 and 3 nodes (one per rack) killed, some token ranges/tablets lose 2-3 replicas -> no quorum (and possibly all replicas lost before removenode); unobservable since errors are swallowed. Candidate for RED unless LWT results get asserted.
